items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Me and him and Eddie Hickman. Three piece.

ctx.x: Ask him about Eddie Hickman. He asked him.

How's about Eddie Hickman? Eddie Hickman, well Eddie Hickman, he had a band. He had George McCullum, he had Artie Crasman, and he had Max Williams, and he had Little Lawrence, Little Lawrence Coleman, and Gitar, no, Gitar, yeah. He's dead too. I believe Eddie's dead too. I read in the paper last week if it's him, you know, Eddie Hickman, you know. It wasn't. I don't know. Oh, you don't know him, man. He's an old musician too. This shot fella, he wasn't much taller than me. He gets mad quick. He's a nice liquor…

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Hickory used to play with him, you see. He used to play with me some time on the job.

ctx.x: Oliver? Oliver? He used to play with them. He used to play with me sometime on the job. but I was a saxophone player. All of them? Yeah. All of them? Yeah, he used to play with, Hickory used to play with him, you see. He used to play with me some time on the job. You know Joe was in there, huh? The drummer, and Henry was in there. Son Johnson, you know that? You know Son Johnson, a saxophone player? Oh, yeah. Where's every artist you know him? He teaches now. He teaches somebody down in the conservatory a long…
That's right. He knows Son Fuclos. Did you know Son Fuclos?
